text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, I gotta say, the way Zephyr talks is 
seriously so cool!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You know, that like... kaze-something, or 
tofu-whatever? That kinda stuff? Mind 
telling me about it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Even if you ask me to teach you... I 
merely weave words that drift in on a 
sudden breeze.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Totally! I have zero clue what 
that means, but I totally feel ya!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, even if you say that... Laying my 
heart bare like this feels as though a 
gentle summer breeze might blow it away...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uuuummmm, so basically... It's 
embarrassing when people come on too 
strong? That's fine, that's fine! I think 
it's cool!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Can I totally use this!? Seriously 
blinding! Woo-hoo~☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. And you don't really need to 
ask for my permission to weave a bond with 
Fuurai, you know.
